name: dana-claude-os
description: One student's personal operating system for Claude: recruiting, equity research, admin, school, and org work as installable plugins that share one private context folder.

plugins.name: recruiting
plugins.description: Finance internship recruiting: cover letters and tailored resumes, online applications, coffee-chat prep, recruiting events onto the calendar, plus a career-finance agent that routes to the right tool.

plugins.name: itc-research
plugins.description: Equity research workbench for a student investment club: single-ticker, compare, screening, and earnings notes, thesis and catalyst tracking, Approved List materials, and a house style that learns from corrections.

plugins.name: personal-admin
plugins.description: Day-to-day admin: inbox triage and reply drafts in your own voice, real availability across every calendar, calendar holds, and a planning agent for tasks and files.

plugins.name: involvement
plugins.description: Student-organization work, starting with a sorority Director of Academics agent: GPA check-in emails, roster upkeep, and Notion task tracking.

plugins.name: academics
plugins.description: Coursework agent for assignments, readings, and class-specific work, built to grow a skill per class.

plugins.name: workflow-miner
plugins.description: Reads past sessions to find manual work you keep repeating, fixes safe config mismatches, and drafts new skills for approval.
